question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 4 pages. How long (in minutes) will he take to type 111 pages?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time required to type 1 page = 40 ÷ 4 = 10 minutes.

Time required to type 111 pages = 111 × 10 = 1110 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 1110 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pages typed initially = 4

Time taken = 40 minutes

Target pages to type = 111

**Formula Used:**

Time taken = (Total Time ÷ Initial Pages) × Target Pages
